About Jaad Logistics

Jaad Logistics moves freight across Nigeria and beyond, trucks and haulage, RORO, sea freight, air freight, and general cargo. We track every shipment from pickup to delivery and keep our customers updated at every stage.

Our Vision

Africa's most trusted logistics partner. A continent fully connected, where businesses move goods across borders without friction and Nigerian enterprise is represented at the highest global standard.

Our Mission

Delivering excellence, every mile. Reliable, efficient, and innovative logistics, connecting Nigerian businesses and individuals to global markets through freight forwarding, international shipping, road haulage, RoRo transport, customs clearing, and end-to-end supply chain management.

Our Purpose

Moving people forward. Behind every shipment is a business owner, a family, or an entrepreneur waiting on us. We remove the barriers that slow commerce so our clients can focus on building their businesses.

We don't just move cargo. We move businesses forward.
